scope: Corrections limited to documentation-verifier test invocation and string matching. No scientific source, measured value, manuscript, online slide, tolerance, or research gate was changed by these corrections.

corrections.resolution: Accept either the explicit machine-readable generator_training_authorized=false boundary or the registry phrase generator unauthorized; retain anti-tamper tests for missing gates and altered slide IDs.

corrections.resolution: Preserve the system-Python failure log and rerun with /root/miniconda3/envs/codonflow/bin/python; final result is 8 passed plus 5 subtests.
